data.component: Cscape HMI Dynamic Contour Plot & 2D Scalar Field Isoline Gradient SCADA Canvas

tests.details: Verified 'ContourCanvasSync' and 'ContourPlotHmiSync' POUs with SecurityGuard & STParser across Horner registers %R1830..%R1837 and %M427..%M428.
Rejected 6/6 forbidden ladder logic constructs with LadderForbiddenError.
Verified 32x24 grid resolution (768 nodes), Min = 120.0 °C, Max = 245.0 °C, Hotspot at (18.4, 12.6), and bilinear continuous interpolation.
Verified Marching Squares 16-case lookup, linear interpolation edge intersections, and continuous path synthesis (394 total segments across 8 levels).
Verified 8 monotonic isoline levels [133.9°C..231.1°C], Cool-to-Warm & Viridis gradient swatches, and numeric contour value badges.
Verified %M428 assertion on T_max > 235.0 °C, de-assertion on T_max <= 235.0 °C, 0xEE03 trip on T_max > 300.0 °C, and nominal recovery.
Verified 0xEE01 (Scalar Field Singularity), 0xEE02 (Marching Squares Grid Fault), and 0xEE04 (SVG Render Fault) with %R1837 latching and nominal reset.

Verified standalone W3C SVG 1.1 with WCAG 2.1 AAA contrast (> 18:1), isoline paths (<path d='M... L...'/>), reticle crosshairs, HUD telemetry card, and legend -> artifacts\HMI\contour_canvas_sample.svg.
Verified %R1830..%R1837 (32, 24, 8, 2450, 1200, 184, 126, 0) and %M427..%M428 (True, True) with PrivilegeMode.SYSTEM and discrete ILogicUnit scan cycle execution.
